description:
Create your invoices, quotes & delivery notes in 10 seconds - easy
𝕘𝟠 is an efficient, open-source invoicing app.

Features:
- Create and manage invoices
- Create delivery slips and convert them into invoices
- Create quotes and convert them into invoices (premium option)
- Create credit memos
- Manage your customers and products
- Custom prices per customer
- Export documents as PDFs
- No account required

Perfect for farmers, freelancers, small businesses, and anyone who needs to create professional invoices.

No ads • No trackers • Optional subscription
Open-source software 🇫🇷

A great deal of effort has gone into developing this app to help you simplify your administrative tasks while protecting your privacy. If you have a question, a problem, or a request, support is always available—just contact Aude at contact@the-gate.fr
